text: All 13 autonomous children (.1-.11, .13) are closed. Only .12 remains open — it is human-labeled because resolving the Hash-vs-extras tension on four JSContact sub-types (NameComponent, AddressComponent, PartialDate, Timestamp) is a design decision with three options (A: drop Hash, B: manual Hash skipping extras, C: exclude four types from policy). Labelling the epic 'human' too so the do-beads loop skips it instead of re-evaluating each session. Re-open by removing the 'human' label once .12 is resolved.
